branch_scope: fixed off-grid dBZ points, declared valid-row errors, known state/boundary; pointwise branch only

problem_identity.scope: fixed point-observation identity; caller also binds code, control, parameters and branch

support.branch_policy: pointwise strict minmod; caller pins expected_branch for endpoint comparison
support.coordinate_convention: fixed (row, column) cell-center indices; strict interior 2x2 stencils
support.initial_background: fixed exogenous state-grid field + theta * fixed pattern
support.observation_errors: per-time fixed point correlation; valid principal submatrix and symmetric inverse sqrt after sqrt(quality)/std
support.observation_masks: all valid and detected; censored/QC unsupported
support.observation_units: dBZ point value; interpolate dBZ after state echo-to-dBZ conversion
